ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in parallelogram $ABCD$, points $E$ and $F$ are located on sides $AB$ and $BC$ respectively, with $DE=AF$ and $DE \perp AF$ at point $G$. If $AB=AD$, $\angle AED=60^\circ$, $AE=6$, and $BF=2$, what is the length of $DE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Extend $CB$ to point $H$, such that $BH=AE$, and connect $AH$, as shown in the figure:\\
$\because$ Quadrilateral $ABCD$ is a parallelogram, and $AB=AD$,\\
$\therefore$ Quadrilateral $ABCD$ is a rhombus,\\
$\therefore$ $AD\parallel BC$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle ABH=\angle BAD$.\\
$\because$ $BH=AE$,\\
$\therefore$ $\triangle DAE\cong \triangle ABH$ (SAS),\\
$\therefore$ $DE=AH$, $\angle AHB=\angle DEA=60^\circ$,\\
$\because$ $DE=AF$,\\
$\therefore$ $AH=AF$,\\
$\therefore$ $\triangle AHF$ is an equilateral triangle,\\
$\therefore$ $AH=HF=BH+BF=AE+BF=6+2=8$,\\
$\therefore$ $DE=AH=\boxed{8}$.

method.method_draft: Analytic vector/law-of-cosines route. Read the diagram as a rhombus with A as a vertex, AB and AD as equal adjacent side vectors, E on AB with AE=6, and F on BC with BF=2 in the direction parallel to AD. Let the common side length be s and let the angle between AB and AD have cosine c. Represent A as the origin, AB as vector s p and AD as vector s q, where p and q are unit vectors with p·q=c. Then E=6p, D=sq, and F=sp+2q. Let x=DE. From angle AED=60°, the angle between EA=-6p and ED=sq-6p satisfies 6-sc=x/2, so sc=6-x/2. Also x^2=|sq-6p|^2=s^2+36-12sc, giving s^2=x^2-6x+36. The condition DE=AF gives x^2=|sp+2q|^2=s^2+4+4sc. Substitute sc=6-x/2 and s^2=x^2-6x+36 to obtain x^2=x^2-6x+36+4+24-2x, hence 8x=64 and x=8.

推理：按向量法。因为ABCD是平行四边形且AB=AD，所以相邻边等长，可把AB和AD表示为同一长度s的两条向量。令A为原点，设AB=s p，AD=s q，其中p、q为单位向量，p·q=c。于是B=s p，D=s q。因为E在AB上且AE=6，所以E=6p；因为F在BC上且BF=2，且BC方向平行AD，所以F=s p+2q。设x=DE。
由∠AED=60°，在点E处，EA=-6p，ED=sq-6p，且|EA|=6，|ED|=x。因此(-6p)·(sq-6p)=6x cos60°=3x。左边为36-6sc，所以36-6sc=3x，即6-sc=x/2，得到sc=6-x/2。

由题设DE=AF，所以x^2=|AF|^2=|sp+2q|^2=s^2+4+4sc。代入s^2=x^2-6x+36和sc=6-x/2，得x^2=x^2-6x+36+4+4(6-x/2)=x^2-8x+64。因此8x=64，x=8。故DE=8。

又x^2=|DE|^2=|sq-6p|^2=s^2+36-12sc。代入sc=6-x/2，得x^2=s^2+36-12(6-x/2)=s^2-36+6x，所以s^2=x^2-6x+36。
由题设DE=AF，所以x^2=|AF|^2=|sp+2q|^2=s^2+4+4sc。代入s^2=x^2-6x+36和sc=6-x/2，得x^2=x^2-6x+36+4+4(6-x/2)=x^2-8x+64。因此8x=64，x=8。故DE=8。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, in parallelogram $ABCD$, points $E$ and $F$ are located on sides $AB$ and $BC$ respectively, with $DE=AF$ and $DE \perp AF$ at point $G$. If $AB=AD$, $\angle AED=60^\circ$, $AE=6$, and $BF=2$, what is the length of $DE$?
raw_record.answer:
Solution: Extend $CB$ to point $H$, such that $BH=AE$, and connect $AH$, as shown in the figure:\\
$\because$ Quadrilateral $ABCD$ is a parallelogram, and $AB=AD$,\\
$\therefore$ Quadrilateral $ABCD$ is a rhombus,\\
$\therefore$ $AD\parallel BC$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle ABH=\angle BAD$.\\
$\because$ $BH=AE$,\\
$\therefore$ $\triangle DAE\cong \triangle ABH$ (SAS),\\
$\therefore$ $DE=AH$, $\angle AHB=\angle DEA=60^\circ$,\\
$\because$ $DE=AF$,\\
$\therefore$ $AH=AF$,\\
$\therefore$ $\triangle AHF$ is an equilateral triangle,\\
$\therefore$ $AH=HF=BH+BF=AE+BF=6+2=8$,\\
$\therefore$ $DE=AH=\boxed{8}$
raw_record.final_cot: First describe the image: There are two subfigures in the figure. The right-side Figure 2 shows parallelogram ABCD, E is on AB, F is on BC, and segment DE intersects AF at G. The left-side Figure 1, on the basis of Figure 2, extends the line on which CB lies to H on the left side of B; dashed lines indicate AH and HB, and H, B, F, C are collinear. Then reason: Because ABCD is a parallelogram and AB=AD, ABCD is a rhombus, so AD∥BC, and BH is on the extension of BC, so AD∥BH. Thus ∠ABH=∠BAD. Construct H so that BH=AE=6. Also AB=AD, and the included angles ∠ABH=∠DAE are correspondingly equal, therefore △ABH≅△DAE (SAS). So AH=DE, and ∠AHB=∠AED=60°. It is known that DE=AF, therefore AH=AF. Since H, B, F are collinear, rays HB and HF have the same direction, so ∠AHF=∠AHB=60°. In △AHF, AH=AF, so base angles ∠AHF=∠HFA; since ∠AHF=60°, then ∠HFA=60°, hence △AHF is an equilateral triangle. Therefore AH=HF. Also HF=BH+BF=AE+BF=6+2=8, so AH=8. Because DE=AH, DE=8.
